description: This PHP class 'LegacyGoogleSyncMigrationService' handles migration of user data from legacy Google Sync system to a new CalendarSync system within SuiteCRM. It manages OAuth token migration, scheduler setup, user data migration, and meeting sync data transfer, including validation and creation of migration marker files.

classes.name: LegacyGoogleSyncMigrationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for migrating user data and meeting sync data from the legacy Google Sync system to the new CalendarSync system, including validation and migration marker creation.

methods.name: executeMigration
methods.description: Performs the complete migration process, including provider setup, scheduler migration, user data migration, and creating a migration marker file.

methods.name: getProviderOrFail
methods.description: Attempts to create or retrieve the external OAuth provider, handling errors and updating migration stats.

methods.name: migrateSchedulerOrFail
methods.description: Attempts to migrate the scheduler, handling errors and updating migration stats.

methods.name: findUsersOrFail
methods.description: Finds all users eligible for migration, handling errors.

methods.name: migrateUsers
methods.description: Iterates over legacy users to migrate each user and their meeting sync data.

methods.name: writeMigrationMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates a marker file indicating migration completion.

methods.name: validateMigrationRequirements
methods.description: Validates system requirements for migration, aggregating issues from various components.
